prompt:
Edit the first attached image, a character dialogue portrait, and keep it identical: same framing, same pose, same position and size of every part, same outlines, colours and shading, same transparent background. Change only two things in the face:
1. Both eyes are fully closed, as in the middle of a blink: each eye becomes a soft downward-curved closed lid line with a few short lashes, at the same place and the same width as the open eye; the fur around the eyes stays as it is.
2. The mouth is wide open as when saying a long, friendly "ah": the lower jaw drops a little, the open mouth shows a dark red-brown interior and a small pink tongue at the bottom, no visible teeth; the black nose, the cheeks and the scarf stay unchanged.
Everything else (cap, ears, scarf, strap, body, parcel) stays exactly as in the first image.
Character dialogue portrait for a 2D narrative adventure game. Style: clean hand-drawn digital storybook illustration; confident dark-brown ink outlines of even medium weight around every shape; soft painted cel shading with one light tone and one shadow tone per material and only a few soft transitions; fur indicated by a few short strokes along the outlines instead of dense texture; the knitted scarf shown with simple rib stripes; flat, clean colour areas that read well at small size. Muted dusk palette: moss and bottle green, brick red, cream, warm brown, charcoal and off-white. A warm orange rim light along the right edge of the figure, as from an evening lantern, and a cool, soft blue-violet fill light from the left. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a plush toy, no airbrush glow, no heavy texture, no painted background.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
The character stays isolated on a fully transparent background (alpha channel).
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.

Painted background for a 2D narrative adventure game dialogue scene, drawn in the same style as the attached character portrait (the portrait only shows the drawing style; the character itself does not appear anywhere in this picture): clean hand-drawn digital storybook illustration with dark-brown ink outlines of even weight, soft painted cel shading with few tones per material, simple shapes and calm surfaces, moderate detail. Muted dusk palette: deep blue and violet sky, a band of warm orange at the horizon, moss green, warm stone grey and brown wood; the lit windows and lamps warm yellow-orange. Large calm areas of sky and water. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a saturated postcard.
Composition for a dialogue screen (a large character portrait will later cover the left 40 percent of the picture and a text box the lower right): the harbour-master's cottage stands at the far left edge, only partly in frame; the iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 52 percent of the width, its glass a small warm glowing spot; the wooden jetty with the two moored fishing boats lies between 45 and 75 percent of the width; the lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at about 84 percent of the width with its top well below the upper edge and open sky around its lamp; the horizon at about 45 percent of the height; calm water with soft vertical reflections of the lights; the quay runs along the bottom of the picture.
Leave out everything that is animated separately: the lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, no smoke from the chimney, no birds, no sparkles, no glow halos or bloom around the lights.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
